def VTask.replaceVertex {V : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph V) (s t : V) [DecidableEq V] : SimpleGraph V :=
  let s_neighborhood := G.Adj s
  let t_neighborhood := G.Adj t
  -- t's new neighborhood is s's old neighborhood
  -- s and t are never adjacent in the result
  -- all other adjacencies remain the same
  ⟨(fun v w => if v = t then w ∈ s_neighborhood else if w = t then v ∈ s_neighborhood else G.Adj v w),
   sorry⟩
